items.informal_name: Sum of Comapped Finite Support Functions under Bijection
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {M : Type u_5} {N : Type u_6} [inst : Zero M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N] (f : α → β)
  (l : β →₀ M) (g : β → M → N) (hf : Set.BijOn f (f ⁻¹' ↑l.support) ↑l.support),
  (Finsupp.comapDomain f l ⋯).sum (g ∘ f) = l.sum g
items.informal_description: Given a function $ f : \alpha \to \beta $ that is bijective on the preimage of the support of a finite support function $ l : \beta \to_0 M $, and a function $ g : \beta \to M \to N $ where $ N $ is an additive commutative monoid, the sum of the comapped finite support function $ \text{comapDomain}(f, l) $ evaluated with $ g \circ f $ equals the sum of $ l $ evaluated with $ g $. Formally, $ (\text{comapDomain}\, f\, l).\text{sum}(g \circ f) = l.\text{sum}(g) $.

items.informal_name: Domain Mapping Commutes with Summation for Finite Support Functions
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {M : Type u_5} {N : Type u_6} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : Zero N] {f : α → β}
  {s : α →₀ N} {v : α → N → α →₀ M}, Finsupp.mapDomain f (s.sum v) = s.sum fun a b => Finsupp.mapDomain f (v a b)
items.informal_description: For any function $ f : \alpha \to \beta $, finite support function $ s : \alpha \to_0 N $, and function $ v : \alpha \times N \to \alpha \to_0 M $, the domain mapping operation commutes with summation: applying $ \text{mapDomain} $ to the sum of $ v $ over $ s $ is equivalent to summing the results of applying $ \text{mapDomain} $ to each individual term $ v(a, b) $. Formally, $ \text{mapDomain}_f \left( \sum_{a, b} v(a, b) \right) = \sum_{a, b} \text{mapDomain}_f(v(a, b)) $, where the sums are over finite supports.

items.informal_name: Compatibility of Sum and MapRange for Finsupp Functions with Zero-Preserving Maps
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} {M' : Type u_9} {N : Type u_10} [inst : Zero M] [inst_1 : Zero M']
  [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid N] {f : M → M'} {hf : f 0 = 0} {g : α →₀ M} {h : α → M' → N},
  (∀ (a : α), h a 0 = 0) → (Finsupp.mapRange f hf g).sum h = g.sum fun a b => h a (f b)
items.informal_description: For functions $ f: M \to M' $ preserving zero ($ f(0) = 0 $) and $ h: \alpha \times M' \to N $ vanishing at zero ($ h(a, 0) = 0 $), the sum over the Finsupp function $ g: \alpha \to_0 M $ after applying $ \text{mapRange}(f) $ to $ g $ equals the sum of $ g $ with $ h $ composed with $ f $, i.e., $ \sum (\text{mapRange}(f, g)).h = \sum g.(\lambda a, h(a, f(-))) $.

items.informal_name: Sum Preservation under Domain Mapping for Additive Homomorphisms
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {M : Type u_5} {N : Type u_6} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N]
  {f : α → β} {s : α →₀ M} {h : β → M → N},
  (∀ (b : β), h b 0 = 0) →
    (∀ (b : β) (m₁ m₂ : M), h b (m₁ + m₂) = h b m₁ + h b m₂) →
      (Finsupp.mapDomain f s).sum h = s.sum fun a m => h (f a) m
items.informal_description: For any function $f : \alpha \to \beta$, finite support function $s : \alpha \to_0 M$, and function $h : \beta \times M \to N$ satisfying $h(b, 0) = 0$ and $h(b, m_1 + m_2) = h(b, m_1) + h(b, m_2)$ for all $b \in \beta$ and $m_1, m_2 \in M$, the sum over $\beta$ of $h(b, (\text{mapDomain } f \, s)(b))$ equals the sum over $\alpha$ of $h(f(a), s(a))$.

items.informal_name: Sum Preservation under Injective Domain Mapping for Finite Support Functions
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {M : Type u_5} {N : Type u_6} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N]
  {f : α → β} {s : α →₀ M} {h : β → M → N},
  Function.Injective f → (Finsupp.mapDomain f s).sum h = s.sum fun a b => h (f a) b
items.informal_description: If $ f : \alpha \to \beta $ is an injective function and $ s : \alpha \to_0 M $ is a finite support function, then for any function $ h : \beta \to M \to N $, the sum of $ h $ over the domain-mapped finite support function $ \text{mapDomain}(f, s) $ equals the sum of $ h(f(a), b) $ over the original finite support function $ s $. Formally, $ \left(\text{mapDomain}(f, s)\right).\text{sum}(h) = s.\text{sum}\left(\lambda a \, b, h(f(a), b)\right) $.

items.name: Finsupp.sum_mapDomain_index_inj
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {M : Type u_5} {N : Type u_6} [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommMonoid N] {f : α → β} {s : α →₀ M} {h : β → M → N} (hf : Function.Injective f) : (Finsupp.mapDomain f s).sum h = s.sum fun a b => h (f a) b

items.type: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {M : Type u_5} {N : Type u_6} [AddCommMonoid M] [Zero N] {f : α → β} {s : α →₀ N} {v : α → N → α →₀ M} : Finsupp.mapDomain f (s.sum v) = s.sum fun a b => Finsupp.mapDomain f (v a b)

items.name: Finsupp.mapDomain_apply
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {M : Type u_5} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : α → β) (x : α →₀ M) (b : β) : (Finsupp.mapDomain f x) b = x.sum fun a m => (fun₀ | f a => m) b

items.name: Finsupp.sum_mapDomain_index
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {M : Type u_5} {N : Type u_6} [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommMonoid N] {f : α → β} {s : α →₀ M} {h : β → M → N} (h_zero : ∀ (b : β), h b 0 = 0) (h_add : ∀ (b : β) (m₁ m₂ : M), h b (m₁ + m₂) = h b m₁ + h b m₂) : (Finsupp.mapDomain f s).sum h = s.sum fun a m => h (f a) m

items.name: Finsupp.sum_mapDomain_index_addMonoidHom
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {M : Type u_5} {N : Type u_6} [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommMonoid N] {f : α → β} {s : α →₀ M} (h : β → M →+ N) : ((Finsupp.mapDomain f s).sum fun b m => (h b) m) = s.sum fun a m => (h (f a)) m

items.name: Algebra.Generators.comp_σ
items.type: {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {ι : Type w} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] {ι' : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} [CommRing T] [Algebra R T] [Algebra S T] [IsScalarTower R S T] (Q : Algebra.Generators S T ι') (P : Algebra.Generators R S ι) (x : T) : (Q.comp P).σ x = (Q.σ x).coeff.sum fun n r => (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inr) (P.σ r) * (MvPolynomial.monomial (Finsupp.mapDomain Sum.inl n)) 1
